notes.title: 🕯️ Tenth Update of Delirium: Echoes of the Domino
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/d99a53de9f3e7616e6e7a8049942074559220286.png"][/img][/p][h3]🏰 New Mode: [b]The Tower[/b][/h3][p]Every ascent demands sacrifice. After each boss battle:[/p][list][*][p]🔹 [b]Lose one random Wild card.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔹 [b]Gain $10 as compensation.[/b]
A mode built for those who thrive on risk and adaptability.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💔 New Boss: [b]Broken Mercy[/b][/h3][p]A constant punishment that corrupts your progress. Each time you discard, a [b]Cursed Domino (-1 | -1)[/b] is added to your bag, weakening your plays. Mercy is gone… only suffering remains.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ UI & Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Visual adjustments for a clearer, more immersive interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Quality-of-life improvements to make every run smoother and more strategic.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]⚔️ With [b]The Tower[/b] and [b]Broken Mercy[/b], the challenge reaches new heights.
Will you keep climbing without losing your balance?[/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Ninth Update: The Devil and the Unstable Flame
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/0373013c729f3cbc6fea6ef9415f8e5fd2c7c16c.png"][/img][/p][h3]🃏 New mode: [b]The Devil[/b][/h3][p]The deal is sealed. [b]You start the game with an extra $10[/b], but at a price: [b]you won't be able to sell any dominoes for the entire run[/b]. A risky choice for those who want to try their luck.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔥 New boss: [b]The Unstable Flame[/b][/h3][p]An unpredictable adversary that consumes everything in its path. [b]Every time you place a token on the board, another token will be randomly destroyed in your bag.[/b] Can you maintain control amidst the chaos?[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️Quality and UI improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Visual tweaks to the interface for a clearer and smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life improvements to streamline matches and make each run more satisfying.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💀 With The Devil and the Unstable Flame, chance has never been so dangerous. Update the game, face the fire, and prove you can master chaos.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🌀 Update 8 – Temperance and The Preacher
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/692bd5eba234f4391af08f6ce3bbbfd8e8a3ced7.png"][/img][/p][h2]✨ New Game Mode: [b]Temperance[/b][/h2][p]A challenge of balance and patience:[/p][list][*][p]You start with [b]one less wild card space[/b].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]However, [b]all double tiles are worth +50 points[/b], becoming key pieces for your strategies![/p][/*][/list][p]Will you be able to maintain control and take advantage of this poisoned blessing?[/p][hr][/hr][h2]👁️ New Boss: The Preacher[/h2][p]A ruthless figure who dictates strange rules on the board:[/p][list][*][p][b]Even pieces don't score points.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Only odd pieces can lead you to victory.[/p][/*][/list][p]Be prepared to change your way of playing: what seemed safe is now worthless.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Interface and quality of life improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Adjustments to wildcard display for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance fixes on higher difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to menus and visual feedback during matches.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🚪 Enter the madness[/h2][p]With each update, Delirium: Echoes of the Domino continues to grow thanks to your support and feedback. Can you master the duality of Temperance and overcome the Preacher's sermon?[/p][p]👉 Play now in [b]Early Access on Steam.[/b][/p]

notes.title: ⚰️ Update 7 – The Death & The Eternal Miser
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/3f376e745d530fbacf7badad69dad074c05d1628.png"][/img][/p][h2]🕒 New Game Mode: [b]The Death[/b][/h2][p]In this mode, the clock becomes your greatest enemy.[/p][list][*][p][b]All runs are played against a 15-minute timer.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Strategy and speed now go hand in hand — every discard, every placement, every decision counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Will you keep your cool under pressure, or will the ticking clock push you into chaos?[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💰 New Boss: [b]The Eternal Miser[/b][/h2][p]A twisted collector of riches who despises generosity.[/p][list][*][p][b]Golden dominoes now score 0 points.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]What was once a blessing turns into a curse, forcing you to rethink your strategy.[/p][/*][*][p]Only the most resourceful players will adapt to this ruthless handicap.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🖥️ Interface & Quality-of-Life Updates[/h2][p]Alongside new content, we’ve also made improvements to make your experience smoother:[/p][list][*][p]Refined UI for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved feedback on scoring and discards.[/p][/*][*][p]Several bug fixes and optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌌 Keep Building the Delirium[/h2][p]With every update, the world of [i]Delirium: Echoes of the Domino[/i] grows deeper and stranger.
Thank you for playing, sharing feedback, and helping shape the game during Early Access.[/p][p]Your journey through the delirium continues…
And remember: [b]time waits for no one.[/b][/p]

notes.title: 💥 Update 4 & 5 – The Wheel of Fortune Spins, The Force, Herald of the Ruin, ...

notes.title: 🔥 Third Update: The Hermit and The Bank Have Arrived
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/81cabb31a7be250ab221b2a16dca1a88d9c8a4ae.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings from the Delirium![/p][p]We’re excited to announce the [b]third major update[/b] for [i]Delirium: Echoes of the Domino[/i]. This patch adds [b]a new game mode[/b] and [b]a new boss[/b] that will test your planning, adaptability, and luck in unexpected ways.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌑 NEW GAME MODE: [b]The Hermit[/b][/h3][quote][p][i]"Sometimes solitude whispers secrets of hidden power."[/i][/p][/quote][p]In this mode, things get a little unstable:
🟥 [b]20% of your dominoes will be red[/b], bringing unpredictable effects that could lead you to glory—or ruin.[/p][p]A perfect pick for those who enjoy a more chaotic run.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧮 NEW BOSS: [b]The Bank[/b][/h3][quote][p][i]"The house always wins. notes.title: Second Update Released: Justice and the Loan Shark Join the Game!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/f0c9035115ceea2b7c7e4e54d58962894c0806ee.png"][/img][/p][h3]🃏 New Game Mode: [b]Justice[/b][/h3][p]Start your run with an entire set of [b]green domino tiles[/b], designed to bring balance… or break it spectacularly. Will you play fair or tilt the scale in your favor?[/p][quote][p][i]"When balance is imposed from the beginning, only the wise know how to bend the rules."[/i][/p][/quote][h3]💰 New Boss: [b]The Loan Shark[/b][/h3][p]Every tile you play will cost you [b]$2[/b]. This boss doesn’t play around — every move you make is a financial burden.[/p][quote][p][i]"Debt is his domain. Each move, another coin lost. Each hesitation, a missed opportunity."[/i][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][p]🎯 This demo now features [b]8 game modes[/b], [b]6 difficulty levels[/b], and [b]11 unique bosses[/b].
Thank you for joining the Delirium — we’ll keep expanding and polishing the game with your feedback.[/p][p]🃏 If you haven’t yet, add the game to your wishlist and share your wildest combos with us![/p]

notes.title: First Update for Delirium - Introducing The Chariot and The Final Cry
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/7b93eea5ecf3027a7008bfd28fd8df154492dad9.png"][/img][/p][h3]🃏 New Game Mode: [b]The Chariot[/b][/h3][p]Inspired by the Major Arcana, [b]The Chariot[/b] changes the pace right from the start. Your initial domino set is made [b]entirely of even numbers[/b].[/p][p]This dramatically alters early-game strategy. No odd tiles means new synergies, new traps… and a new path to master.[/p][p][b]Description[/b]:[/p][quote][p][i]Victory requires direction. The Chariot doesn’t move without control: every play, every decision, defines your destiny.[/i][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]👹 New Boss: [b]The Final Cry[/b][/h3][p]A new threat emerges to twist your run into something unforgettable. [b]The Final Cry[/b] brings a brutal mechanic to the board:
💥 [b]High Stakes Wager[/b] — You’ll earn more… but only if you survive the risk.[/p][p][b]Description[/b]:[/p][quote][p][i]A voice you can’t hear, but one that demands everything. Are you willing to risk it all for just a few more points?[/i][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]✨ And this is just the beginning…[/h3][p]We’ll keep adding new game modes, bosses, global upgrades, and features to expand and refine [i]Delirium[/i]. Thank you for playing, sharing your thoughts, and helping us shape this chaotic domino roguelike.[/p][p]If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to [b]leave a review[/b] — and join the community discussions to help us improve with every update.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Welcome back to the Delirium.
– The [i]Delirium: Echoes of the Domino[/i] Team[/p]
